We've been using their services for about six months now!

Thanks to the always warm and welcoming staff, we feel completely at ease leaving our dogs in their care.

The photos taken every month are incredibly cute, and our dogs always come back having so much fun playing at the dog run.

The staff's service is wonderful, and this place is indispensable for our dogs. We look forward to continuing to use your services! 🙏🏻

At first, I was worried because my dog ​​seemed nervous, but now he looks so happy to go to kindergarten on kindergarten days, and I'm so glad I chose this place.

We look forward to seeing the videos and photos you send us each time, and our whole family is soothed by seeing him having fun and playing freely. You keep us informed of even the smallest details, so we can rest assured even when we're away.

It's clear that the staff treat each dog with such love and care, tailoring their approach to each individual dog's personality. This is a wonderful and trustworthy kindergarten.

I can confidently recommend this place to anyone looking for a dog kindergarten! 😚

Thank you so much for your feedback!

We are deeply humbled by your exceptionally high rating.

We will continue to strive to provide even better service to live up to your expectations and expectations.

We look forward to your continued support. 🙇
They also help us with training and other aspects of caring for the dogs we rescue.

Thank you for your feedback!

We look forward to your continued support!

We've been using your services for about two years now.

All the staff are so kind and loving, and I can see that my dog ​​feels safe and enjoys herself.

She used to be afraid of people and large dogs, but thanks to this class, she's become much more comfortable.

We look forward to continuing to use your services.

We've been going to this daycare since it opened.
My dog ​​is a difficult one; he doesn't like anyone outside of the family and isn't interested in other dogs he meets on walks. However, the teachers and staff are always so kind to him that he seems to have come to understand, and now he's affectionate and even rubs against people.
He seems to get along well with the other dogs at the daycare and even greets them.
When I hear that he went for a walk with a spring in his step, even though he hates walks at home, I'm so glad I sent him to daycare.
They take him to all sorts of places for events, and in the summer he gets to swim in the pool.

He sleeps all the time at home, so the daycare where he can move around a lot is a great help.
I hope that in the future he'll be able to stop barking at everyone and be petted by all of them! I'll continue sending him there with that wish in mind!

My 14-year-old Miniature Dachshund suffers from separation anxiety, and I find this place invaluable as a place to leave him when I have to leave the house. The long hours, from 8 am to 7 pm, are also very convenient for my work schedule. I believe it's an important environment for my dog ​​to develop social skills in the dog world.

My dog ​​is always well cared for here.

When she arrives at the daycare, she seems so happy that she doesn't even notice me, so I feel at ease knowing that they're taking good care of her even when I'm not around.

Thank you for your continued support 🐶
The vet is always kind and friendly, and always provides a daily report with photos. I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care. Thank you for your continued support. …
